SCHEDULE: {"1":"Hana","2":"Ann","3":"Dev","4":"Ben","5":"Cara","6":"Finn","7":"Gus","8":"Elif","9":"Ivo"}
CONFIDENCE: 98

Dev must be in slot 3. Ben = Dev+1 and Ann < Ben, so Ann is before Dev. Hana and Ann are adjacent with Hana < Dev, so they take slots 1 and 2. Finn must be at least Dev+3 because Ben and Cara occupy Dev+1 and Dev+2, and Dev < Finn < Gus < Elif < Ivo forces Finn 6, Gus 7, Elif 8, Ivo 9.

The team note's alternative (Dev in slot 4) fails. It would put Ann after Dev, which breaks Ann < Ben, and it would push Ivo past slot 9.

I checked all 19 constraints against this schedule. Cara and Gus have exactly one person between them (Finn), and Ben and Elif are four slots apart.
